_about.what: Vaal Cultivation Orb outcomes ('Cultivated' uniques; the game files say 'Mutated'): the orb 'Replaces up to 2 modifiers on a [Corrupted] [UniqueCulture|Vaal Unique]' (Incursion2Crafting, Mutate Unique). Added in 0.4.0 (Fate of the Vaal), core since 0.5.0 (patch notes 0.5.0 line 173).
_about.sources: game files build 26476662 (Mods.json GenerationType 3 'UniqueMutatedVaal*'; Incursion2MutatedUniqueModsClient 'OriginalMods'); poe2db Vaal Cultivation Orb page (48 uniques, saved 14 Nov 2026); PoB ModItemExclusive.lua text; data/pob-bb52d6b368/coverage.json
_about.weights: UNVERIFIED: the client files carry no outcome weights (the 204 rows' SpawnWeight lists are empty) and poe2db shows none; how many lines are replaced (1 or 2) and which line goes is random (poe2db's wiki text: 'The modifier that gets replaced on the unique are random'), odds unknown.
_about.replaceable: a line's 'replaceable' is true when its text matches one of the game's 242 OriginalMods; false means only that the text did not match (UNVERIFIED, not 'cannot be replaced')
